required_data: project_slug, post_id, title, city, developer/source note, public_use_policy
allowed_primary_surface: Identity strip above the visual stage
owner_acceptance_gate: Project identity is visible before buyer actions and no official claim appears without source.
screenshot_gate: Desktop first viewport and mobile first viewport.

required_data: asset status for model, facade, poster, drawings, units, tour, map/environment
allowed_primary_surface: Invisible gate that chooses the honest visual state
owner_acceptance_gate: Exactly one primary asset state is chosen: official model, official facade, approved concept, or missing material.

trigger: Official model URL, poster, and unit camera data pass validation
required_data: project_model_glb, project_model_poster, unit hotspot_position, hotspot_normal, camera_orbit
blocked_if_missing: model URL, poster, unit camera data, or load event
owner_acceptance_gate: Unit selection changes focus/camera where data exists. If the model fails, the page shows a clean unavailable state.
screenshot_gate: Desktop idle, selected unit, mobile selected unit.

required_data: project_3d_facade_images with approved=true and concept=false, viewbox, polygon/points per unit
allowed_primary_surface: Facade image with mapped unit areas or floor bands
blocked_if_missing: approved facade image, viewbox, or unit mapping
owner_acceptance_gate: The facade is a real approved asset and selected unit visibly maps to the facade or floor band.
screenshot_gate: Desktop facade selected, mobile facade selected.

trigger: Only approved concept or generated planning asset exists
required_data: facade image with concept=true or public_use_policy requiring illustrative labels
allowed_primary_surface: Concept visual stage with visible caution copy
owner_acceptance_gate: Concept is visibly marked as illustrative and never sold as official developer material.
screenshot_gate: Desktop concept state and mobile concept state.

required_data: project identity, required asset checklist, upload/contact target
allowed_primary_surface: Premium missing-material state with contractor upload CTA
owner_acceptance_gate: The page looks intentional, explains what is missing, and does not invent a facade/model/map.
screenshot_gate: Desktop missing state and mobile missing state.

trigger: Model, facade, map, or tour load fails after data exists
required_data: asset URL, error code/log, user-safe message
allowed_primary_surface: Clean unavailable panel with retry and contact path
owner_acceptance_gate: No broken canvas, blank stage, console-only error, or hidden failure. Error is logged for admin follow-up.
screenshot_gate: Broken model, broken facade, broken map.

trigger: Project has one or more units after schema validation
required_data: project_3d_units, unit id, floor, rooms, sqm, status, source_note
owner_acceptance_gate: Tap targets are large, selection is stable, and unavailable units are not sold as available.
screenshot_gate: Desktop unit list and mobile selector.

required_data: selected unit fields, plan/view/tour availability, price note, lead context
allowed_primary_surface: Selected unit card or mobile bottom sheet
owner_acceptance_gate: Selected unit shows floor, rooms, area, direction/view, status, source note, and next action without covering the visual stage.
screenshot_gate: Mobile bottom sheet open and desktop side card.

trigger: Selected unit has approved or illustrative plan
owner_acceptance_gate: Plan is shown only with source status. Missing plan becomes an upload/request state, not a fake plan.

trigger: Project exists but unit list is empty or unapproved
required_data: project identity, developer/source, asset checklist, inquiry CTA
owner_acceptance_gate: The page can still sell the project but does not show invented units, prices, or availability.

trigger: Environment layer has approved source data
blocked_if_missing: source note or precise coordinate status
owner_acceptance_gate: Nearby projects, parks, transit, and services are shown only with source status and planned/live labels.

trigger: Map token, precise coordinates, or source data is missing
required_data: safe map unavailable copy, project identity, source checklist
allowed_primary_surface: Map not-ready panel, not a fake map
owner_acceptance_gate: No fake pins or schematic pins are presented as survey coordinates.

trigger: Selected unit or project has approved tour/video/interior link
owner_acceptance_gate: Tour opens only when the link is real and sourced. Missing tour becomes a contractor asset request.

trigger: Buyer asks to contact, save, compare, or request details
required_data: project_slug, unit id, asset state, source page, language, consent, lead destination
owner_acceptance_gate: Lead payload includes project and unit context, but no unsupported price or availability promise.
